turns.replyText:
I understand that sometimes a product might not be the perfect fit for your home. We offer a 30-Day Happiness Guarantee, which means you can return or exchange your item for any reason within 30 days of delivery.

Tumble covers the shipping costs for returns and exchanges within the contiguous U.S. and Canada. To be eligible for a refund or exchange, items must be in new and sellable condition, with no visible damage, stains, or pet hair. Please note that rug swatches are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. Additionally, our policy allows for one exchange per item.
